events.name: Yule
events.text: The Sunwait goes on: the candles burn the weeks down to the longest night. !sunwait shows which rune is awake.

events.name: Moon Night
events.text: The moon is full tonight. Moon Night: omens run wild, Beings stir sooner, the Madness flows a little thicker.

events.name: The Onyx Fair of Inquanok
events.text: Onyx Tickets for turning up and staying; flares at the booth and the Veiled Priest's fortunes. See the Onyx Fair page.
